name: Demon Slice
doc: Demon Slice (Seifer's enemy attack 314, c0m086): flames around the target, the caster sliding toward him under a fading layout, the wave layout at the caster swelling and lifting the caster and the target, rising layouts, the slash layout and a hit at the target every 5 ticks with the caster swinging and the blade trail of slot 4's bone 1, two white flashes, the push layout with the target pushed back and hidden, the caster back with sparkles round him, the target dropped back at his start and drawn turned over by the module under the fall layout, the screen flash, the sounds; the action result at tick 0xDB. Bloodfest 210's twin. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag251_demon_slice.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools in the magic buffer); its texture is exe data (the setup's TIM), its file loader the engine's null sub.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

parts.title: Master
parts.doc: The main task's ticks, its three sounds, the screen flash rising and falling; the TIM and the camera

parts.title: Caster
parts.doc: The caster sliding toward the target, swinging between two points by him, then back to his start (the effect moves him, it draws nothing)

parts.title: Flames
parts.doc: Flames around the target (Fire's parts), each with its ground glow, embers rising and sparks drifting

parts.title: Opening
parts.doc: Layout A at the caster's spawn point, fading out

parts.title: Wave
parts.doc: The wave layout at the caster's spawn point, its vertices pushed by a travelling wave, its texture scrolling; it swells, then grows taller as it lifts the caster and the target

parts.title: Risers
parts.doc: Layout tasks rising above the caster's spawn point while the wave plays

parts.title: Slash
parts.doc: The slash layout at the caster's spawn point of its first tick, its texture scrolling

parts.title: Hits
parts.doc: A hit layout task at the target every few ticks, with his hit chain

parts.title: Push
parts.doc: The push layout at the target's effect point; the target pushed back a step a tick, hidden at its end

parts.title: Target
parts.doc: The target back at his start, dropped from above, drawn by the module turned over about his middle; then his result

parts.title: Fall
parts.doc: The fall layout at the target's start, his hit chain at its first tick

parts.title: White flashes
parts.doc: Two full-screen flashes (fading in, held, fading out)

parts.title: Blade trail
parts.doc: The blade trail of slot 4's bone 1: a ring of its last 7 points splined, drawn as gouraud quads fading along it

parts.title: Sparkles
parts.doc: Sparkles flying out round the caster when he is back
